title: Embeddings + Rerank: Quickstart UX visual kit and pipeline screenshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact visual kit and screenshot set for the Embeddings + Rerank quickstart. Deliverables include a 1-page pipeline diagram (linear flow + optional batching/caching callouts), two mobile/tablet friendly screenshots of the Console quickstart, a code snippet screenshot for the SDK showing embeddings + rerank API calls, and sample output cards demonstrating before/after rerank quality. Goal: reduce time to first successful rerank demo for new users and improve copy clarity in docs.
acceptance_criteria: One optimized pipeline diagram (SVG + PNG) that fits hero section of quickstart page and a simplified 2-step variant for email/slide use
Two Console screenshots (desktop wide and mobile narrow) with redacted customer data and annotated CTA overlays
SDK code snippet image (light + dark theme) showing embeddings ingestion, candidate retrieval, rerank call and sample scored outputs
Three sample output cards (raw search, embedding similarity, rerank final) with synthetic but realistic text examples and score badges
Figma file handoff with component tokens and naming matching docs style guide
Designer review sign-off and PM approval recorded in comments and linked artifacts

2026-03-08 Reviewer (PM - L. Gomez): Feedback — make scores visually prominent, add a short microcopy explaining score meaning, and show time-to-first-token metric on Console screenshot. Also request a downloadable PNG for marketing.

2026-03-09 Maya Chen: Updated diagrams with score badges, microcopy 'higher is better — 0.0 to 1.0', added latency placeholder and removed verbose labels on mobile variant. Uploaded new artboards to Figma.

2026-03-10 Eng feedback (ENG-2981): Suggested adding an optional 'rerank fallback' note indicating automatic fallback to CPU model when GPU quantized candidate set not available. Marked as dependency and added to diagram as small caution icon.

Design QA checklist: color contrast passes AA, captions under screenshots under 120 chars, file sizes optimized (<200KB hero PNG), and SVG diagram optimized for HTML embedding.
